claude.country: United States, United Kingdom, Finland, South Korea
claude.sample_unit: patients (development cohort; external validation cohorts 31,932 UK, 23,100 US, 7,295 Korea, 3,934 Finland)

links.outcome: External validation performance with cross-site versus development-site-only feature selection
links.effect: Models trained with cross-site feature selection significantly outperformed those using only development-site features in external validation (P < .05).
links.quote: Models trained with cross-site feature selection significantly outperformed those using only features from the development site through external validation (P < .05).

links.outcome: AUROC drop from local to external validation across sites
links.effect: Top Lasso logistic regression model AUROC 0.75 in local validation versus 0.69 (SD = 0.02) averaged in external validation.
links.quote: The top-performing model, Lasso logistic regression, achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.75 during local validation and 0.69 (SD = 0.02) (averaged) in external validation.

unlisted_practices: Cross-site feature selection during model development to improve generalizability
